items.title: Motorola Solutions (MSI) Stock Looks Overvalued Even After Strong Cash Flow Growth
items.summary: Motorola Solutions has delivered a strong share price run in recent years, and the market is now reacting to fresh news on profit, acquisitions and capital returns. With the stock around US$530.40, the key question is whether that price still lines up with the cash flows the business can generate over time. items.title: Axon Sinks 27% in a Week to a New 52-Week Low. Is the Selling Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAxon shares fell 27% in a week to a new 52-week low after a revenue miss and a lower 2026 outlook. Delayed federal Dedrone deployments drove the cut, while Motorola Solutions and Tyler Technologies point to healthy demand.

items.title: Axon vs. Motorola: Which Public Safety Stock Has More Upside After Q3 Earnings?
items.summary: Axon shares fell about 28% after an EPS miss and cautious guidance, while Motorola Solutions rose roughly 7% on an earnings beat, raised guidance, and record backlog in their Q3 2026 reports.
